name: The Ritz-Carlton, Bachelor Gulch
insider_take: Perched at 8,100 feet in the Colorado Rockies, this ski-in/ski-out sanctuary offers unparalleled access to Beaver Creek's legendary terrain and après-ski culture.
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton, Bachelor Gulch is the only ski-in/ski-out hotel in Beaver Creek, featuring direct access to the Arrowhead Express Lift. The property sits on Bachelor Gulch Mountain, named after early settlers who found the area so remote that only bachelors would venture there. The hotel's signature Buffalos Restaurant & Bar showcases locally-sourced Rocky Mountain cuisine, while the 21,000-square-foot spa draws mineral-rich water from natural hot springs.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the spa's outdoor relaxation pools during snowfall for an unforgettable alpine wellness experience, and don't miss the complimentary fresh-baked cookies served every afternoon in the lobby.
dont_miss: The famous Beaver Creek Village's daily 3 PM fresh-baked chocolate chip cookie tradition (just a short shuttle ride away), ice skating on the outdoor rink surrounded by twinkling lights, and the Birds of Prey World Cup downhill ski races held annually on the challenging slopes visible from the hotel.
pros: Ski-in/ski-out access to Beaver Creek Resort
Multiple dining options including fine dining restaurants
Elegant mountain lodge architecture with stunning views
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury mountain resort status
Remote mountain location requires travel planning
